evidence.quote: Microsoft Copilot Studio is a graphical, low-code studio for building and managing AI-powered agents and workflows.
Build agents and workflows, connect them to your organization's data and systems, and publish them to the channels where your users already work.
Agent flows are the established flow format in Copilot Studio, with an authoring experience similar to Power Automate but native to Copilot Studio.
By default, new agents use generative orchestration.
An agent that uses generative orchestration can choose the best tools, knowledge, topics, and other agents to answer user queries or respond to event triggers.
If the agent selects multiple tools, agents, or topics, it calls them in sequence, after generating any questions to ask the user for missing information.
Tools are building blocks that let your agent interact with external systems.

You can use the following mechanisms to add tools to your agent: Connector: Connect to proprietary APIs and services by using Power Platform Connectors to pull in data or carry out actions. Prebuilt connector: Choose from a selection of preset connections to thousands of popular APIs from both Microsoft and non-Microsoft services. Custom connector: Define a connection to a custom service or system to enable custom tool options by using Power Platform Connectors. The connector needs view and share permissions for the organization for the agent to use the connector. Agent flow: Define an agent flow, including one or more actions to carry out. Prompt: Single turn model-based prompt that can reference knowledge you provide and generate code to analyze data. REST API: Define a connection to a REST API, and select one or more API endpoints and methods to add as tools. Model Context Protocol: Connect to an MCP server to access tools and resources. Computer use: Lets your agent interact with any system that has a graphical user interface, for websites and desktop apps, selecting buttons, choosing menus, and entering text into fields on the screen.
Your organization can use governance policies to restrict which tools and connectors are available in Copilot Studio.

Copilot Studio follows a number of security and governance controls and processes, including geographic data residency, data loss prevention (DLP), multiple standards certifications, regulatory compliance, environment routing, and regional customization.

Microsoft Agent 365 serves as a central control plane to observe, govern, and secure Copilot Studio agents. For organizations that onboard Agent 365, Copilot Studio agents can be represented as identities in Microsoft Entra.

Admins can use data policies in the Power Platform admin center to govern the use and availability of Copilot Studio features and agent capabilities, including: Maker and user authentication Knowledge sources Actions, connectors, and skills HTTP requests Publication to channels Azure Monitor Application Insights Triggers
Admins have full visibility into maker audit logs in Microsoft Purview. Agent 365 complements this with centralized agent inventory and lifecycle context that can be correlated with audit records.
As you move from building to running solutions in production, Copilot Studio helps you monitor, govern, and improve them:

Evaluations — validate quality with test sets and a shared grader library before and after you publish. Administration — inventory, secure, and manage agents across your organization, with role-based access and cost management.

claims.wording: Copilot Studio is a low-code studio for agents, workflows and agent flows that connect to business data and publish to work channels.
Generative orchestration lets agents choose tools, knowledge, topics or other agents, ask for missing inputs and compose responses.
Tools move intent to action through connectors, agent flows, prompts, REST APIs, MCP and computer use, with policy restrictions available.
Enterprise control includes data policies, audit visibility, Agent 365 governance, Entra agent identities and security controls.
Executives should treat Copilot Studio as a managed agent platform with monitoring, governance, evaluations, administration and policy gates.
